children.subject: address keyword search and location facets are offered only in the checkout shipping address popup
children.question: Where can a shopper search their addresses and filter them by country, state or city?
children.body: The keyword search and the country / state / city facet dropdowns backed by currentCustomerAddresses and currentOrganizationAddresses are wired only into the checkout shipping address-selection popup on /cart. The /account/addresses page and the header ship-to popover call the same queries but show only the plain list with Add/Edit/Delete - that scope is intentional. The State/Province facet appears only when the listed addresses include US or Canadian ones: other countries carry no region, so the facet request returns an empty term list and the facet is hidden, BY DESIGN.

why: (a) the correction that orders can be deleted is about a different API (DELETE /api/order/customerOrders) and Admin orders-list controls, separate from the cancel cascade

children.subject: cancelling an order cancels its payment on a background job but never its shipment
children.question: What happens to an order's shipment and payment when the order is cancelled?
children.body: Cancelling an order cascades to the PAYMENT and not to the SHIPMENT. The order goes to Cancelled with isCancelled true, cancelledDate set and cancelReason carrying the dialog text; its inPayment follows about 1.7 seconds later on a background job, reaching status Cancelled, isCancelled true and cancelledState Completed; its shipment stays at status New with isCancelled false and a modifiedDate still equal to its createdDate, never written again. The mechanism is that CancelPaymentOrderChangedEventHandler collects changedEntry.NewEntry.InPayments only, and no shipment-cancelling handler exists anywhere in the Orders module. So a cancelled order leaves a live shipment document behind, and anything counting open shipments - a fulfilment queue, a warehouse worklist - keeps seeing it; this is why a store used for order testing accumulates New shipments belonging to orders that are all Cancelled. Reproduced independently by three separate runs on 2026-09-15.

why: (a) the platform-wide scope of the combine-policy setting is reached through a different API (platform settings) from the promotion's own store/candidacy rules

children.subject: an empty promotion store list means the promotion applies in every store
children.question: This promotion has no store on it - does that mean it applies nowhere, or everywhere?
children.body: Everywhere. A promotion's store axis is a LIST (storeIds, rendered on the blade as 'Stores' with the caption 'Stores where this promotion applies'), and an EMPTY list means every store, not no store - established the hard way: a promotion whose storeIds is [] produced the discount row on an order placed in a specific store, while a promotion in the same list naming one other store could not reach it. So candidacy is gated by four independent things, none of which the promotions grid shows together: the isActive flag, the store list (empty = all), the start and expiration dates, and the conditions (the blade offers customer criteria - first time buyer, user group - then catalog conditions, then cart conditions). The grid's Active column is the isActive flag ALONE: a promotion can sit there as Active with an expiration date years in the past and a store list that excludes the store you are testing, and nothing on that screen says so. Priority is a field on the promotion and is not what breaks a tie between two cart-subtotal rewards.

children.subject: submitting a return raises one registered-return email notification and one push message whose topic is the return number
children.question: What notifications does submitting a return produce, and how do I find them in the notification journal and push message search?
children.body: Each xAPI submitReturn (Draft -> Requested) produced exactly one ReturnRegisteredEmailNotification row in POST /api/notifications/journal with tenantIdentity {id: returnId, type: Return} - status Error on a deployment without SMTP (SentNotificationException), which still proves it was raised - and exactly one push message in POST /api/push-message/search with topic = the return number, shortMessage 'Return <number> received', memberIds = [the buyer contact id], status Sent. Decisions raise ReturnPartiallyApprovedEmailNotification / ReturnRejectedEmailNotification with push texts 'partly approved' / 'declined'. Observed on VirtoCommerce.Return 3.1003.0-pr-27-51fc, PushMessages 3.1006.0-pr-28-2027.
